question: The Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme, approved by the Government of India in January 2025, provides what percentage of guarantee coverage for credit facility to member lending institutions?
solution:
The correct answer is **__60%__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme was approved by the Government of India in January 2025 to provide financial support to lending institutions.
 
• The scheme offers a guarantee coverage of **60%** on the credit facility extended by member lending institutions to eligible borrowers.
